titulo: Me: just 5 more minutes on the couch
caption:
Just 5 more minutes on the couch. Then the clock got busy.
18:00 to 21:15, one full procrastination spiral, and Cella (the little door of NAOS) is proud of every minute.
Receipt attached. Same time tomorrow.
